get.summary: List orders (admin: all + filters, driver: own)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Accepts a single OrderStatus (e.g. 'CREATED'), one of the UI-tab aliases 'created' | 'assigned' | 'in_progress' | 'delivered' | 'cancelled' | 'disputed', or a CSV mixing both (e.g. 'CREATED,assigned'). The 'in_progress' alias expands to ACCEPTED, EN_ROUTE_PICKUP, AT_PICKUP, LOADING, IN_TRANSIT and AT_DELIVERY. Matching is case-insensitive; an unrecognised token is rejected with 400.

parameters.name: deliveredFrom
parameters.description: Filter by deliveredAt >= this instant. Independent of `from`/`to`, which window `pickupWindowStart`; both may be sent together. Selects orders that have arrived — DELIVERED, and anything DISPUTED after it was delivered — and excludes everything still in flight or cancelled.

parameters.name: deliveredTo
parameters.description: Filter by deliveredAt <= this instant. See `deliveredFrom` for how it relates to `from`/`to`.

info.title: TruckConnect API
info.description: Boutique transport marketplace backend. Full contract in docs/00_BLUEPRINT_TECNICO.md.

deliveredWeightKg.description: Kilograms carried by the orders counted in `delivered`, to 2 decimals. Attributed to the pickup day, matching the `delivered` count beside it — a run picked up Tuesday and dropped Wednesday weighs into Tuesday.

delivered.description: Orders whose `deliveredAt` falls on this business day, whenever they were picked up. DELIVERED only: a run disputed after delivery keeps its `deliveredAt` but is not counted here.

deliveredWeightKg.description: Kilograms carried by the orders counted in `delivered`, to 2 decimals.
